newsitem.title: PERU: Peru 9-mos current account deficit falls vs yr ago.
newsitem.headline: Peru 9-mos current account deficit falls vs yr ago.

text.p: Peru's current account deficit in the first nine months of 1996 fell to 5.4 percent of Gross Domestic Product (GDP) from 6.9 percent in the first nine months of 1995, the central bank said on Friday.

The Central Reserve Bank said the fall was equivalent to $543 million and was accompanied by an increase in domestic saving to 18.0 percent of GDP in the period January-September 1996 from 17.2 percent in the same 1995 period.
It said lower external public debt service costs and a lower trade deficit during the same period also contributed to the fall in the current account deficit.
